verdict.rationale: The docs say employees must configure federal (W-4-type) and state tax information as part of their onboarding. Gusto Embedded also offers pre-built UI Flows and a React SDK that could host an onboarding experience. However, the evidence never shows a self-serve link sent to a new hire, never mentions I-9 collection, and only covers bank and direct-deposit details for contractors and company setup, not for employee onboarding. Missing for 10: documented new-hire self-serve invite/onboarding flow, I-9 collection, employee bank/direct-deposit capture during onboarding, pre-day-one timing, independent corroboration.
